overclaims: The studies justify caution about inferring word knowledge from fluent prediction.
checks.note: Statement excerpt, proposition, criteria and outcome (historical_observation, not_applicable, unresolved) all match. The e2 excerpt 'shortcomings of language models' cuts 'with respect to tracking entities', so the finding reads as a general one. The e1 excerpt 'using novel words in a sentence.' drops the actual finding ('appears to be at least proficient'). The rationale credits both studies with justifying caution, but only e2 supports that. The packet flags e1 as material counterevidence.
